title: Mulch Blowing vs. Hand Spreading: Which Is Worth the Cost in Chicago?
intro: For Chicago homeowners, maintaining a vibrant, healthy landscape is a point of pride, but it often involves navigating a unique set of challenges posed by our city's distinct climate and soil conditions. One of the most effective, yet often underestimated, practices in achieving this is proper mulching. Mulch is far more than just an aesthetic enhancement; it's a critical layer of protection for your plants, soil, and overall garden health. However, once you've decided on the type of mulch, the next crucial question arises: how should it be applied? This decision between traditional hand spreading and the modern technique of mulch blowing can significantly impact not only the efficiency and cost of the project but also the long-term health and appearance of your Chicago landscape. Let's delve into the intricacies of both methods to help you determine which is the most valuable investment for your specific property.
